remarks: Welcome to Woodside Green - where exceptional rental living awaits you at the heart of downtown Stamford. This magnificent 2-bedroom unit boasts generously proportioned rooms that warmly embrace you from the moment you enter. Set in a prime location, it's a commuter's dream with effortless access to public transportation. Moreover, being just a stone's throw away from the Ridgeway shopping center, grocery stores, restaurants, and fitness centers, everything you require is conveniently within reach. Inside, you'll revel in a well-lit and spacious interior, complemented by beautiful hardwood floors that exude an air of elegance. The monthly rent includes cooking gas and hot water, and two parking spots provide added convenience. Please note, move-ins are only available during weekdays.
